The '''Promenade''' was a glitzy and extravagant commercial district of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The area was run by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and boasted [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], boutiques, and a massive [[Gold/Legends|golden]] statue of [[Karagga]] in the center of the Promenade square.

The district was known for being the safest and most "legitimate" on the Smuggler's Moon. Every Hutt clan contributed a portion of their security force to maintain its order and safety.
